newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - November 13.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - November 13.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Sri Lankan press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
United Nations censures LTTE's use of child soldiers.
Army chief Lt. General Rohan Daluwatte says security forces have started new series of limited search and destroy operations against LTTE in east.
LTTE sabotages electricity distribution in Batticaloa after Ceylon Electricity Board cuts power to areas under rebel control.
Army finds anti-tank weapons and mortar rounds in search in west Valikamam in Jaffna peninsula.
LTTE stocks 1,000 coffins in Batticaloa in preparation for major assault.
Defence Ministry sets up all-island mobile service to recruit youth into army.
